messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: Venture term sheets — what's market in 2026
messages.plaintextBody: Join us on Thursday 11 December, 12:30–13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room, for a CPD session on current market terms in UK venture financings (liquidation preferences, anti-dilution and founder vesting). Sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour. Register via the L&D portal.
